# doit_widget (Data Source)

Beta. Read precomputed current-month cloud spend and forecast metrics. Widget results are
refreshed in the background; reading a widget returns the latest cached result and never
starts a synchronous refresh. Use the list operation to discover the complete catalogue.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    doit = {
      source  = "doitintl/doit"
      version = "~> 1.0"
    }
    local = {
      source  = "hashicorp/local"
      version = "~> 2.5"
    }
  }
}

# Fetch the current month cloud spend widget using its stable alias
data "doit_widget" "spend" {
  widget_id = "current-month-cloud-spend"
}

# Fetch the current month cloud forecast widget using its stable alias
data "doit_widget" "forecast" {
  widget_id = "current-month-cloud-forecast"
}

# Output formatted metrics
output "spend_metrics" {
  description = "Current month cloud spend metric details"
  value = {
    widget_id    = data.doit_widget.spend.id
    alias        = data.doit_widget.spend.alias
    amount       = data.doit_widget.spend.result.monetary_metric.value.amount
    currency     = data.doit_widget.spend.result.monetary_metric.value.currency
    period_start = data.doit_widget.spend.result.monetary_metric.period.start_time
    period_end   = data.doit_widget.spend.result.monetary_metric.period.end_time
    mom_growth   = data.doit_widget.spend.result.monetary_metric.month_to_month_growth_percentage
    generated_at = data.doit_widget.spend.generate_time
  }
}

# Export widget metrics to CSV format
resource "local_file" "widget_metrics_csv" {
  filename = "${path.module}/widget_metrics.csv"
  content = join("\n", [
    "alias,amount,currency,period_start,period_end,mom_growth_amount,mom_growth_percentage,generated_at",
    join(",", [
      data.doit_widget.spend.alias,
      data.doit_widget.spend.result.monetary_metric.value.amount,
      data.doit_widget.spend.result.monetary_metric.value.currency,
      data.doit_widget.spend.result.monetary_metric.period.start_time,
      data.doit_widget.spend.result.monetary_metric.period.end_time,
      data.doit_widget.spend.result.monetary_metric.month_to_month_growth_amount != null ? data.doit_widget.spend.result.monetary_metric.month_to_month_growth_amount.amount : "",
      data.doit_widget.spend.result.monetary_metric.month_to_month_growth_percentage != null ? tostring(data.doit_widget.spend.result.monetary_metric.month_to_month_growth_percentage) : "",
      data.doit_widget.spend.generate_time,
    ]),
    join(",", [
      data.doit_widget.forecast.alias,
      data.doit_widget.forecast.result.monetary_metric.value.amount,
      data.doit_widget.forecast.result.monetary_metric.value.currency,
      data.doit_widget.forecast.result.monetary_metric.period.start_time,
      data.doit_widget.forecast.result.monetary_metric.period.end_time,
      data.doit_widget.forecast.result.monetary_metric.month_to_month_growth_amount != null ? data.doit_widget.forecast.result.monetary_metric.month_to_month_growth_amount.amount : "",
      data.doit_widget.forecast.result.monetary_metric.month_to_month_growth_percentage != null ? tostring(data.doit_widget.forecast.result.monetary_metric.month_to_month_growth_percentage) : "",
      data.doit_widget.forecast.generate_time,
    ]),
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `widget_id` (String) Stable widget alias or customer-specific widget ID returned by listWidgets. Use
current-month-cloud-spend for current-month accumulated spend or
current-month-cloud-forecast for the current-month forecast.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `alias` (String) Stable customer-facing widget identifier.
- `generate_time` (String) Time when the cached result was generated by the background computation.
- `id` (String) Customer- and tier-specific widget id. This value can vary between customers.
- `kind` (String) Determines which property is populated in the widget's `result`.
- `result` (Attributes) Computed widget result. The populated property corresponds to `kind`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--result))
- `type` (String) Whether the widget is supplied by DoiT or defined by a customer.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--result"></a>
### Nested Schema for `result`

Read-Only:

- `monetary_metric` (Attributes) A monetary value over a period and its comparison with the equivalent prior period.
`monthToMonthGrowthPercentage` and `monthToMonthGrowthAmount` are both `null` when no
comparable prior-period value exists, such as when prior-period spend is zero. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--result--monetary_metric))

<a id="nestedatt--result--monetary_metric"></a>
### Nested Schema for `result.monetary_metric`

Read-Only:

- `month_to_month_growth_amount` (Attributes) Absolute monetary change from the comparable prior period, or `null` when no comparison is available. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--result--monetary_metric--month_to_month_growth_amount))
- `month_to_month_growth_percentage` (Number) Percentage change from the comparable prior period, or `null` when no comparison is available.
- `period` (Attributes) UTC date-time range covered by the widget result. `endTime` is exclusive. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--result--monetary_metric--period))
- `value` (Attributes) Current-period monetary value. `amount` is a decimal string and `currency` is an ISO 4217 code. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--result--monetary_metric--value))

<a id="nestedatt--result--monetary_metric--month_to_month_growth_amount"></a>
### Nested Schema for `result.monetary_metric.month_to_month_growth_amount`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) Decimal monetary amount at ISO 4217 minor-unit precision (string).
- `currency` (String) ISO 4217 currency code.


<a id="nestedatt--result--monetary_metric--period"></a>
### Nested Schema for `result.monetary_metric.period`

Read-Only:

- `end_time` (String) Exclusive end of the period.
- `start_time` (String) Inclusive start of the period.


<a id="nestedatt--result--monetary_metric--value"></a>
### Nested Schema for `result.monetary_metric.value`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) Decimal monetary amount at ISO 4217 minor-unit precision (string).
- `currency` (String) ISO 4217 currency code.
